name: Vartable for WooCommerce
author: M Sohaib Qayyum

sections.description:
Vartable for WooCommerce is a powerful WooCommerce plugin that replaces the default variation dropdown with a fully featured, professional-looking table. Customers can see all product variations at a glance, search and filter them, and add multiple items to the cart at once.

Key Features

Table Display
* Shows all product variations in a clean, responsive table
* Auto-displays on product pages or place anywhere with a shortcode
* Supports multiple tables per site with different settings each

Columns (fully customizable)
* Image, Name, Categories, Tags, Reviews, Stock, Price, Total, SKU, Size/Variation, Quantity, Buy Button
* Per-column text color, width, height, font size, font weight, custom CSS class and ID

Search & Filter
* Live search bar searches by name, SKU, price, size, stock status, categories
* Category filter dropdown — filter variations by product category
* Pagination show 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 or 50 rows per page

Styling & Templates
* 8 pre-built color templates: Soft Purple, Sage Green, Sky Blue, Warm Taupe, Burnt Orange, Silver Linen, Dusty Teal, Frost Grey
* Full color control: header, text, alternate rows, buttons, borders
* Responsive design works on desktop, tablet and mobile

Cart & Buying
* Add single variation to cart directly from the table
* Bulk Add to Cart select multiple variations and add all at once
* Quantity input per row with min/max/step support
* Real-time total price calculation per row (uses your WooCommerce currency format)
* Optional WhatsApp ordering — turn Add to Cart buttons into prefilled “Order on WhatsApp” links

Simple Products
* Multi-Product Simple Table create a single table listing multiple simple products together (great for bulk-buy / catalog-style pages)
* Place it on any page or post with its shortcode
* Add to cart, search, filter and compare all work with simple products too

Stock & Notifications
* Custom stock status text — e.g. “Spaces Available” instead of “In Stock” for courses, events and services
* Out-of-stock “Notify Me” button with email subscription
* Custom stock status icons (emoji supported)
* Low stock threshold setting
* Hide out-of-stock variations option
* Show/hide stock quantity

Compare Feature
* Variation comparison mode select multiple variations and compare side by side
* Floating compare bar with drawer panel

Advanced Settings
* Choose table position on product page (before/after add to cart, before/after summary)
* Show table on all products, specific products, or exclude certain products
* Show/hide sale badge, images, stock quantity
* Multi-language support (English, Urdu, Arabic, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian, Hindi)
* English texts are translatable with Loco Translate or .po files

Shortcode Usage

Auto-detect the table for the current product (Elementor / custom product templates):

[wcvtp_variations_table]

Show a specific table (copy the shortcode from Variation Table → My Tables):

[wcvtp_variations_table id="wcvtp_1712345678_123"]

Show the table for a specific product on any page:

[wcvtp_variations_table product_id="123"]

Who Is This For?

  • WooCommerce store owners selling products with multiple variations (sizes, colors, etc.)
  • Wholesale stores needing bulk ordering
  • Course, event and booking sites (“Spaces Available”)
  • Fashion, apparel, sports, and electronics stores
  • Anyone looking for a better variation display than the default WooCommerce dropdown
sections.installation:
1. Upload the product-variation-table folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Variation Table in your WordPress admin menu
  4. Click Add New Table to create your first variation table
  5. Configure columns, styling, and settings as needed
  6. The table will auto-display on your product pages, or use the shortcode [wcvtp_variations_table]
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active for this plugin to work.

Can I display the table on non-product pages?

Yes! Use [wcvtp_variations_table product_id="YOUR_PRODUCT_ID"] on any page, post or widget. A Multi-Product Simple Table can be placed anywhere with its own shortcode from My Tables.

Can I change “In Stock” to my own text, like “Spaces Available”?

Yes. Edit your table, open the Display tab and fill in Stock Status Text. You can change the In Stock, Out of Stock, Backorder and quantity texts (use {qty} for the number, e.g. “{qty} spaces left”). Leave a field empty to keep the default text.

Can I translate the plugin with Loco Translate?

Yes. Keep the table language on English and translate the “product-variation-table” text domain with Loco Translate. For a quick wording change of the stock texts, use Display → Stock Status Text instead.

Can I have different table styles for different products?

Yes. You can create multiple tables with different settings and assign them to specific products using the product selection option.

Does it work with variable products only?

No. It supports variable products and simple products — both as part of a Multi-Product Simple Table and on individual simple product pages.

Is it mobile friendly?

Yes. The table is fully responsive and adjusts for desktop, tablet and mobile screens.

Can customers add multiple variations to cart at once?

Yes. Enable the “Bulk Add to Cart” option and customers can select quantities for multiple variations and add them all in one click.

What columns can I show in the table?

You can enable or disable: Image, Name, Categories, Tags, Reviews, Stock, Price, Total, SKU, Size/Variation, Quantity, and Buy Button.

Can I change the colors of the table?

Yes. Full color control is available — header background, header text, alternate row colors, button colors, border color. You can also choose from 8 pre-built templates.

Does it support RTL languages?

Yes. The plugin includes translation support and works with RTL languages including Urdu and Arabic.

How does the Notify Me feature work?

When a variation is out of stock, a “Notify Me” button appears in the Action column. Customers can enter their email and are notified automatically when the product is back in stock.

Can customers compare variations?

Yes. Enable the compare mode and customers can select multiple variations to view them side by side in a comparison drawer.

What is the Multi-Product Simple Table?

It lets you select multiple simple (non-variable) WooCommerce products and display them together in a single bulk-buy table. The table automatically appears on each selected product’s page, and can also be placed on any page or post using its shortcode.

Does it support ordering via WhatsApp?

Yes. Edit your table, enable WhatsApp Ordering in the General tab and enter your WhatsApp number. The table’s Add to Cart buttons become WhatsApp order links, prefilled with product, quantity, price and total details.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • New: Custom Stock Status Text (Display tab) — change “In Stock”, “Out of Stock”, “On Backorder” and “{qty} in stock” to your own wording, e.g. “Spaces Available”.
  • New: English frontend texts can now be translated with Loco Translate / .po files.
  • New: WhatsApp Ordering is now a per-table setting with its own WhatsApp number field (General tab). It is off by default, so a WhatsApp chat widget on the page no longer replaces the cart buttons.
  • New: wcvtp_i18n_strings filter to change any table text from code.
  • Fix: Column style settings (text color, height, font size, font weight) and Custom ID were not applied on the frontend.
  • Fix: Column width setting was saved but never used.
  • Fix: Search and category filter did not work on tablet and mobile.
  • Fix: Multi-Product Simple Table shortcode showed “Invalid product” on normal pages.
  • Fix: [wcvtp_variations_table] (Elementor) could show a Multi-Product Simple Table on unrelated products.
  • Fix: Fatal error when sending a Notify Me email for a simple product, and on the Stock Alerts page.
  • Fix: Fatal error for simple products that have product attributes.
  • Fix: Notify Me emails are now also sent when the stock status is changed manually.
  • Fix: Clicking an “Order on WhatsApp” link also triggered an add to cart request.
  • Fix: Table was cut off on tablets.
  • Fix: Default WooCommerce add to cart form flashed before being hidden.
  • Fix: Category filter matched partial names (e.g. “shirts” also matched “t-shirts”).
  • Fix: Prices in totals now follow the WooCommerce currency position, decimals and separators.
  • Fix: Admin product search ignored the typed text.
  • Fix: Custom class/ID/style of a column was lost after changing its column type in the admin.
  • Fix: Duplicate columns of the same type were merged after reload.
  • Fix: Pressing Enter in a quantity field now adds the row to the cart.
  • Fix: Button text was reset to English after adding to cart.
  • Fix: WooCommerce error messages (e.g. not enough stock) are now shown when add to cart fails.
  • Fix: Importing a .json file was rejected on some systems.
  • Fix: Shortcodes inside widgets / page builders on non-product pages did not load the table scripts.
  • Improvement: Removed the duplicate “Enable” switch inside table settings — use the table Status switch.
  • Improvement: Output escaping and input sanitization hardening.
  • Improvement: Uninstall no longer flushes the whole site object cache.

1.0.3

  • New Feature: Simple Products Multi-Product Table. Select multiple simple products to display together in one bulk-buy table — automatically shown on each selected product’s page (for easy comparison), and also placeable anywhere via shortcode.
  • New Feature: WhatsApp ordering automatically converts Add to Cart buttons into WhatsApp order links when a WhatsApp button is detected on the page.
  • Added 2 new color templates (now 8 total): Dusty Teal and Frost Grey.
  • Redesigned existing color templates with a refreshed palette: Soft Purple, Sage Green, Sky Blue, Warm Taupe, Burnt Orange, Silver Linen.
  • Product search in admin now returns both variable and simple products for “Only Selected Products” mode.
  • Add to Cart (single + bulk) now supports simple products alongside existing variable product support.
  • Compare feature works seamlessly with simple product rows.
  • Improved category/tag search indexing for multi-product tables.
  • Minor UI text and admin save-indicator improvements.

1.0.2

  • Bug fixes and improvements.

1.0.1

  • Bug fixes and improvements.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Variable product variation table display
  • 12 customizable columns
  • Live search with full-text indexing
  • Category filter dropdown
  • Pagination support
  • 6 pre-built color templates
  • Full color customization (header, rows, buttons, borders)
  • Alternate row text color control
  • Bulk Add to Cart functionality
  • Per-row quantity inputs with min/max/step
  • Real-time total price per row
  • Out-of-stock Notify Me button with email subscription
  • Variation comparison mode
  • Auto-display on product pages
  • Shortcode support
  • Multiple tables support
  • Product selection (all / include / exclude)
  • 11 language translations
  • Mobile responsive layout
  • Stock status icons (emoji)
  • Sale badge support
  • Low stock threshold
  • Hide out-of-stock option
  • Settings export/import
  • Cache management
